notes: Version 1.0.220 — two major additions: a clickable client selection report built from .acerep import (with .roa export straight from the client's own browser), and partner reports (for shops that send you recovery jobs on their clients' behalf). Also includes thumbnail report fixes and small interface polish.
changelog: New: import a .acerep report and generate a clickable client selection report — folder tree with checkboxes (nothing selected by default), Lost & Found folders automatically sorted to the top and highlighted when they contain important files (documents/photos/videos), hover tooltips on large folders with little valuable data, a file search box, and a report-language switcher (14 languages) — the client can review and select everything without contacting the lab
The client exports a .roa file with one click, straight from their own browser — compatible with DEViewer, no round-trip through the app

New: partner reports — keep a list of partners (e.g. computer shops that send you recovery jobs on their clients' behalf) in settings, each with their own name, logo, and description. A new, third button generates a report with the partner's details instead of your lab's — colors and styling stay yours
Fixed bug: in normal reports with thumbnails, the 'OK only' filter could show an empty folder even though no file actually had a confirmed status
Photos with a generated thumbnail are now moved to the top of the file list in a folder, so the client sees them right away without scrolling
